subject: Small issue with the gate instructions
text:
Hi neighbor,

I’m handling the building support notes and noticed the posted instruction about the back gate is unclear. It says press, wait, then turn, but nobody said how long to wait, and the keypad light sometimes blinks before it works. I tried twice, and both times the latch felt jammed after I followed the card. Maybe someone changed the procedure without updating the sign. Could you check with whoever installed it? I don’t want people forcing the handle at night. The sign has a coffee stain, so please reprint it.

Thanks,
Support desk
